title: A deposit taken under the payer reduces what the payer owes
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, with a part sold at $210.00 and a $50.00 deposit taken under customer B, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Create Invoice.
  4. Apply the $50.00 deposit to the invoice.
  5. Open customer B's Invoices tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows the $50.00 deposit and Create Invoice.

Step 3:

  • The invoice for $210.00 is created.

Step 4:

  • The invoice's balance is $160.00 ($210.00 − $50.00).

Step 5:

  • Work order 1's invoice shows Total $210.00 and Balance $160.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12312 (Story 10, Receivables follow the Bill To)

  • S10-R2: “A deposit is taken on the account of whoever is the Bill To when it is recorded.”
  • S10-R9: “A payment can use only deposits and credits held by the paying customer; otherwise it is refused with M5.”
  • Feature Overview, State by action (Action | Open | Invoiced | Internal or No Charge): “Take a deposit | Allowed; lands on the Bill To's account | As today | n/a”
